name: Neural Radiative Transfer via Physics-Informed Optimization
aliases: Neural Inverse Rendering for Participating Media
definition: A method for reconstructing spatially varying optical properties (absorption, scattering, phase function) and the light field of participating media from posed RGB images, using physics-informed neural optimization to enforce the Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) and boundary conditions.
summary: Neural Radiative Transfer via Physics-Informed Optimization reconstructs volumetric optical properties and light fields from images by enforcing the Radiative Transfer Equation as a local pointwise constraint, unlike surface-based methods relying on stochastic ray sampling.
